# git: config: set autocorrect

Turn on git's interactive command autocorrection. **Motivation:** developer experience — `git psuh` should offer to run `git push` instead of only printing "the most similar command is". Setting: `git config --global help.autoCorrect prompt`, the mode introduced in Git 2.34 ([release highlights](https://github.blog/2021-11-15-highlights-from-git-2-34/)), which asks `y/n` before rerunning, in contrast to `immediate` or a delay in deciseconds.
